description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterV2 class, which handles writing media frame data and associated metadata into shared memory buffers, including serialization of metadata using protobuf. It includes functions for converting enums to protobuf types, building metadata objects, and writing frames with error handling.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
classes.description: A class responsible for writing media frames and their metadata into shared memory buffers, supporting both audio and video segments, with protobuf serialization.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterV2
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with shared memory buffer and media info, setting up metadata version and zeroing memory.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory, serializing metadata and data, with error handling for insufficient space and serialization failures.

methods.name: buildMetadata
methods.description: Builds a protobuf metadata object from a media segment, including media-specific fields and encryption info.
